items.coder_A: gbm_only, uncertain (WHO grade IV glioma per a 2025 Chinese guideline; GBM never named)
items.reason: Inclusion is "WHO grade IV glioma as defined in the 'Integrated Diagnosis and Treatment Guidelines for Glioma of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association'" with no IDH requirement; manual §1.1 (D27C) counts grade 4 glioma without an IDH requirement as historical glioblastoma (gbm_only). The record cites a national guideline, not WHO CNS5 itself, so CNS5 terminology is not triggered.

note: Coder A's concern is real: a 2025 guideline likely follows CNS5, under which 'grade 4 glioma' also covers IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4 and H3K27M DMG; but the manual rule settles it as historical GBM. Paclitaxel with electroacupuncture BBB opening is device_dependent (C12, manual R4); D30-R1 does not apply because paclitaxel is not an established GBM drug.
